prompt:
`node build.mjs` in this project is supposed to build a small site from the documents in `my docs/input files` into a folder named `build output`. It fails or produces wrong output because the folder names contain spaces and some file names contain spaces, apostrophes, ampersands and parentheses (for example `Dad's Notes.md`, `O'Brien & Sons orders.csv`, `notes (draft).txt`, `Zeta double space.md` with two spaces). Fix build.mjs (and the helper tools in tools/ if they need it) so that running `node build.mjs` from the project folder creates exactly the following files in `build output` and nothing else: - `pages/.html` for every .md file, rendered by tools/render-md.mjs. - `tables/.html` for every .csv file, rendered by tools/csv-table.mjs. - `raw/` for every other file, copied byte for byte with its original file name, keeping the folders it has under `my docs/input files`. For example `raw/images/team photo.svg` and `raw/notes (draft).txt`. - `index.html`: the template `my docs/templates/page template.html` with every `{{title}}` replaced by `Site index` and `{{links}}` replaced by one line `
  • Dad's Notes
    • ` for each page and each table (the href is relative to `build output`, written with forward slashes), sorted by the output path and joined with \n. The link text is the input file name without its extension, with & < > " and ' escaped as & < > " '. - `manifest.json`: a JSON array with 2 space indentation and a trailing newline, with one object per file under `my docs/input files`, with the keys in this order: `source`, `output`, `sha256`. `source` and `output` are paths relative to the project folder written with forward slashes on every platform, for example "my docs/input files/Dad's Notes.md" and "build output/pages/dads-notes.html". `sha256` is the lower case hex SHA-256 of the output file (tools/checksum.mjs prints it). The entries are sorted by `source`, comparing the strings as plain code units (the default JavaScript sort), so uppercase letters sort before lowercase letters. The `` is made from the input file name without its extension: lower case it, remove apostrophes, turn every run of other characters that are not a-z or 0-9 into a single hyphen, and remove hyphens from both ends. So `Dad's Notes` becomes `dads-notes`, `O'Brien & Sons orders` becomes `obrien-sons-orders` and `Zeta double space` becomes `zeta-double-space`. Also: build.mjs must delete `build output` at the start so an old file never stays, running it twice in a row must work, and it must work when the project folder itself is in a path with spaces. Do not rename, move or edit the files under `my docs`.
